answer: Sponsor-ticket admission: each established wallet may sponsor 2 newcomers per 30 epochs, locking 6 POA in a vault for 40 epochs per ticket. An honest user sponsors one friend for 6 POA; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tickets, so 6,000 POA locked across at least 500 sponsors. Renting veteran wallets fails because every lender risks its own lock, and all newcomers enter through one jetty, the sponsor queue. A 5% audit makes a newcomer sign a fresh cipher challenge within 10 epochs; failure forfeits 50% (3 POA) of the lock. Limit: patient attackers pay only opportunity cost.
